_doc: Gap closures of the canvas family (p15-oracle-083), applied to scripts/cmux-next/every-action-gaps.json by p15-oracle-087. Every id needed the canvasLayout context. The fixture (scripts/cmux-next/oracle/action_fixtures/canvas.py) splits the base pane into A | (B / (C | D)) with D focused, then runs toggleCanvasLayout. Each closed id says what it changes on that canvas, so its sample runs a handler and is not refused. canvasRevealFocusedPane needs the same context but stays in `excluded` (the SKIPS pattern `reveal`), not here.

closed.canvasAlignBottom: B moves down to the bottom edge A and D share
closed.canvasAlignLeft: B, C and D move to A's left edge
closed.canvasAlignRight: A and C move to the right edge B and D share
closed.canvasAlignTop: C and D move up to the top edge A and B share
closed.canvasDistributeHorizontally: of B and C (same left edge), the second packs right of the first at the 16 pt canvas gap
closed.canvasDistributeVertically: of A and B (both at the top), the second packs below the first at the 16 pt canvas gap
closed.canvasEqualizeHeights: A takes the height of D, the focused pane (B and C have it already)
closed.canvasEqualizeWidths: A and B take the width of D, the focused pane (C has it already)
closed.canvasOverview: fits the four panes in the viewport (a second run returns to the camera before it)
closed.canvasTidy: B, whose center is above A's, starts its own row
closed.canvasZoomIn: zoom 1 to 1.25 about the viewport center
closed.canvasZoomOut: zoom 1 to 0.8 about the viewport center
closed.canvasZoomReset: PREPARE runs canvasZoomIn first: a fresh canvas is at zoom 1, where Actual Size refuses
